utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still okay with helping, but I’d really like the pickup time and who’s bringing the tools sorted first. Once we’ve got that, I can feel much better about the plan.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — let’s lock down the pickup time and tool plan first, then I can help check what we already have on hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great — thanks, Quinn! I’ll keep checking for the dates and drop-off spot, and I’ll tell you if I hear any new donation details too.

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.text: Hana: Hi Bo — I want to double-check the details before I say for sure. What exactly is the repair drive covering?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s for neighborhood repairs—if you’ve got anything broken or urgent, I can help flag it and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for anything broken or urgent in the neighborhood. Thanks for clarifying, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Kira — I’d like to check in with a few neighbors and note what repairs they need, especially anything urgent so I can organize the list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m in, but I want to make sure the timing and pickup details are sorted first. Can you confirm who’s handling the flyers and where the drop-off spot is?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — I’ll confirm the flyers and drop-off spot, then share those details with you right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect — let’s meet by the front porch this afternoon, and I’ll bring the donated tools. We can go over the list together and get started on the railing and door.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll meet you by the front porch this afternoon with the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by after school pickup if that helps. Just tell me what time you need me there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That works for me—after school pickup is fine. What time can you get there?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can be there around 3:30 after pickup. Just send me the details for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Could you tell folks we still need a cordless drill and a few extra screwdrivers? I keep misplacing mine, so any help would be a relief.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note that we still need a cordless drill and a few extra screwdrivers. If you have the repair drive location and time, I can keep that straight too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, it’s the community center on Maple around 3 this afternoon, if that still works. Thanks for keeping it straight — I’d probably forget my own head if it wasn’t attached.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out and pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — that’d help a lot. Just let me know if you hear anything new, and I’ll try not to miss it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve checked the supplies and set aside the extras for the drive. We still need a few things, but I’ve got a quick list ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Cleo—please send me the list and I’ll keep the organizing side moving. I’ll note what we still need and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll send it over right away and keep setting aside anything we already have.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got a screwdriver set you can borrow — I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — that works. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Leo — I’ll drop it off soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check what’s still needed and let everyone know the next step. If anything changes, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll check what’s still needed and keep everyone posted on the next step. If anything urgent comes up, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That still works for me. Just point me to the place, and I’ll note the loose railing and squeaky door before we head over this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — I’ll check the pickup time and confirm who’s bringing the tools, then I’ll send you the details before this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Pia. I’ll wait for your details and keep my notes ready for this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell — I can help a little, but I need to keep it quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — I’ll keep it quiet. Just let me know if you want help with anything small later.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate that. If I need anything small later, I’ll let you know quietly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Could you tell folks we still need a cordless drill and a few extra screwdrivers? I keep misplacing mine, so any help would be a relief.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah? Can you confirm when it’s happening and where to drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m a bit foggy on the timing, but I can tell you the drop-off spot once I check. I’ll get that sorted and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll swing by around 3.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, 3 works for me. I’ll be there and can help however needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — see you then. I’ll bring whatever I can to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll connect them and send the repair drive details around 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll pass that along while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — thank you! I’ll send everything over around 3:30, and we’ll get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — I’ll bring over the screwdriver set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Gus—thank you. I’ll keep track of the supplies and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help, Mara. Just let me know if you need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina — I’m checking what we’ve got on hand and what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I mean household repairs—like leaky faucets, broken cabinets, or patching walls. What’s the drive covering?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — we’re covering basic household fixes like leaky faucets, broken cabinets, wall patches, and similar small repairs. I’ll keep sorting the supplies list and see what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — community center at 10 a.m. I’ll note that down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s right — the community center at 10 a.m. is the drop-off spot. I’m still checking the flyer for the full dates and details, and I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ve got the drop-off spot and time noted. Just send the full dates and details when you confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks, Vik. Just let me know what you need and I’ll try to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll ask around the block and see who’s free, then I’ll let you know what timing works best.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I might miss a few updates, but I’ll watch for your message and help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the drop-off table.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam — that’s a huge help. I’ll head over after pickup and I’m happy to coordinate around the school times.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem, Faye — I’ll keep things moving until you get there. Just let me know if the school schedule changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll swing by late and help load whatever you still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — before I commit, can you tell me exactly what the repair drive is collecting?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It’s mostly basic repair supplies and whatever’s still short for the drive — I can help load the last bits once Cleo checks the list.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
